label: def:hecke-curvature-2-cocycle
title: Hecke curvature 2-cocycle $F$
html:
Definition. Hecke curvature 2-cocycle F

Definition (Hecke curvature 2-cocycle). The Hecke curvature 2-cocycle is the 2-form-valued bilinear map F \in C^2(H_n(R, q), H_n(R, q)) defined on generator pairs by the deviation from Hecke and Yang-Baxter flat relations:

  F(\sigma_i, \sigma_j) \;=\;
  \begin{cases}
    R_H(i) & \text{if } i = j, \\
    R_{YB}(i) & \text{if } |i - j| = 1, \\
    [\sigma_i, \sigma_j] & \text{if } |i - j| \geq 2.
  \end{cases}

It extends to general elements via the Leibniz rule. It measures the failure of commutativity and normal-form flatness at each generator pair.
